services.name: Rainier Kids Day Camp
services.desc: Please note that this video highlights elements from all of our youth programs. For more information about Rainier Kids Day Camp activities, see the “A Typical Day at Rainier Kids Day Camp” section below. Rainier Kids Day Camp provides the perfect opportunity to get outside and play! Your camper will have a blast hanging out with new friends and awesome counselors, eating tasty lunches, and enjoying a variety of outdoor activities in Cascades’ wilderness. Rainier Kids Day Camp is the safe, smart, and economical choice for your camper’s daytime summer fun. Summertime is all about enjoying the day, playing outside, and being creative; that’s exactly what your camper can expect at Rainier Kids

services.name: Youth Programs
services.desc: Take your faith to the next level and get a taste of camp from the inside out with the S.A.L.T. program! The three-tiered Servant And Leadership Training program is an intense, hands-on discipleship experience modeled after Jesus’ servant-leader example. Each level of this program is designed to help you further identify your God-given gifts and then put them to practice in a variety of areas. You’ll grow in confidence and skill as you learn to serve in different capacities at camp. Your time at Cascades will be jam-packed with relevant worship, service around camp, inspiring bible study, challenging discussions, and epic “S.A.L.T. only” activities with your friends. The S.A.L.T. Program
